method: QLoRA: 4-bit NF4 base (double quantization), LoRA adapter trained with TRL SFTTrainer, loss on the answer only

inference_decoding.note: greedy decoding (argmax), no sampling: temperature 0, seed not used

provenance.reason: The original records.jsonl used for training stayed in the Colab runtime and was lost; manifest.json is the original.
provenance.data: bist_data.zip (prices and macro up to 2026-09-10); the same result is obtained with the full local cache
provenance.match_with_original_manifest: 1230 records; by_task, by_family, holdout_tickers and seed identical. report_status differs by one record: WATCH 121 vs 122, TECHNICAL_REVERSAL_CANDIDATE 30 vs 29 (manifest_regenerated.json). Most likely a price-data difference in the original Colab run.
provenance.note: Targets are deterministic templates over tool outputs, not model text, so the file is rebuilt by running the builder. The current code builds different records; check out builder_commit first.

dataset.split: src.llm.training_data.stable_split (train+test used for training, validation for eval)

manifest.target_source: deterministic_template (tool outputs + summaries.py), not model generated
